note: Test-id ledger for engine-split Phase 2b Batch R (readers onto the installed surface: Tasks R1 and R2), built against base 3372ccdec2 (origin/main). Ids are relative to each collection ROOT: the engine ones to packages/engine, the tools/matrix ones to tools/matrix, the apps/web ones to apps/web. Run: node scripts/lib/test-parity.mjs --before <web>=<base>/apps/web --before <matrix>=<base>/tools/matrix --before <engine>=<base>/packages/engine --after <web>=apps/web --after <matrix>=tools/matrix --after <engine>=packages/engine --ledger this-file, each report collected with `vitest run --isolate -t __parity_collect_only__` over the SEVEN reader files (apps/web: double-walkover-seating, public-player-matches, timeline, player-matches.test.tsx; tools/matrix: applicability, streams, scenarios) and the four engine files this batch touches (dossiers, corpora, rules-reference, publish-manifest). RESULT: the seven reader files hold the same tests before and after (web 183 -> 183, matrix 979 -> 979); the only changes are the three retitles and the thirteen new tests below.
